get.description: Returns basic property information and sales comparables for the subject property based on ranges specified.
get.summary: Returns comparable sales for a property address.

parameters.name: apikey
parameters.description: Application Key

parameters.name: street
parameters.description: Subject property: Street address

parameters.name: city
parameters.description: Subject property: City name. Use "-" to skip.

parameters.name: county
parameters.description: Subject property: County name. Use "-" to skip.

parameters.name: state
parameters.description: Subject property: State code. Use "-" to skip.

parameters.name: zip
parameters.description: Subject property: Zip code. Use "-" to skip.

parameters.name: searchType
parameters.description: Search Method: Search type [Radius | ApnBookAndPage | ApnBook | ZipCode | SubdivisionTract | Countywide]. (Default: Radius)

parameters.name: minComps
parameters.description: Format - int32. Search Method: Min Comps Nr. (Default: 1)

parameters.name: maxComps
parameters.description: Format - int32. Search Method: Max Comps Nr. (Default: 10)

parameters.name: miles
parameters.description: Format - double. Search Method: Miles. (Default: 5)

parameters.name: sameCity
parameters.description: Search Method: Same City. (Default: False)

parameters.name: useSameTargetCode
parameters.description: Use Code: Use Code Same as Target Property. (Default: True)

parameters.name: useCode
parameters.description: Use Code: Selected Use Codes. (Default: NULL)

parameters.name: bedroomsRange
parameters.description: Format - int32. Property Characteristics: Bedrooms Range. (Default: 2)

parameters.name: bathroomRange
parameters.description: Format - int32. Property Characteristics: Bathrooms Range. (Default: 2)

parameters.name: sqFeetRange
parameters.description: Format - int32. Property Characteristics: Square Feet Range. (Default: 600)

parameters.name: lotSizeRange
parameters.description: Format - int32. Property Characteristics: Lot Size Range. (Default: 2000)

parameters.name: onlyPropertiesWithPool
parameters.description: Property Characteristics: Only Properties With Pool. (Default: False)

parameters.name: saleDateRange
parameters.description: Format - int32. Property Characteristics: Sale Date Range in months. (Default: 6)

parameters.name: saleAmountRangeFrom
parameters.description: Format - int32. Property Characteristics: Sale Amount Range From. (Default: NULL)

parameters.name: saleAmountRangeTo
parameters.description: Format - int32. Property Characteristics: Sale Amount Range To. (Default: NULL)

parameters.name: unitNumberRange
parameters.description: Format - int32. Property Characteristics: Units Nr Range. (Default: NULL)

parameters.name: yearBuiltRange
parameters.description: Format - int32. Property Characteristics: Year Built Range. (Default: 10)

parameters.name: storiesRange
parameters.description: Format - int32. Property Characteristics: Stories Range. (Default: NULL)

parameters.name: include0SalesAmounts
parameters.description: Options: Include 0 Or Unknown Sales Amounts. (Default: True)

parameters.name: includeFullSalesOnly
parameters.description: Options: Include Full Sales Only. (Default: False)

parameters.name: ownerOccupied
parameters.description: Options: Owner Occupied [ IncludeOwnerOccupiedOnly | IncludeAbsentOwnerOnly | Both]. (Default: Both)

parameters.name: distressed
parameters.description: Options: Distressed [ExcludeDistressed | OnlyDistressed | IncludeDistressed]. (Default: IncludeDistressed)
